# update go tools

Bump the pinned versions of the Go tools ([[DOT-67]]) to their current releases. The title is the whole note; in December 2019 the pins lived in `toolset/go.mod` and moving them was a manual `go get`/`go mod tidy` pass followed by a rebuild.
